name: @lazily-hub/lazily-html
description: Isomorphic fine-grained HTML renderer on @lazily-hub/lazily-js. Preact/React-compatible API (Component class, hooks, createElement/h, createContext, forwardRef, memo, render, renderToString) with Solid-style run-once components: setState writes a lazily Source and only the affected DOM expressions patch. No VDOM diffing. Browser + server (SSR) from one package.

scripts.build: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/owner.js && node --check src/instance.js && node --check src/hooks.js && node --check src/context.js && node --check src/create-element.js && node --check src/mount.js && node --check src/lite.js && node --check src/component.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check src/synced-view.js && node --check src/hydrate.js && node --check src/full/index.js && node --check src/full/client.js && node --check src/full/reconcile.js && node --check src/full/constants.js && node --check src/full/hyper.js && node scripts/update-size-limits.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:size && node --test test/*.test.js
